finding.claim: Unauthenticated SSRF: any visitor can make the server fetch an arbitrary URL via file_get_contents. The body length is echoed back, giving a size oracle for internal resources (cloud metadata, localhost services). Wrappers such as file:// and php:// are also accepted, so local files can be probed by size.

trace.note: Any POST request with a 'feed' parameter enters the branch; there is no require_admin() call
The value is passed unvalidated to file_get_contents, which follows http/https/ftp/file/php wrappers and redirects
strlen($xml) is echoed to the caller, a blind response-size oracle

finding.guards_checked: No scheme or host allowlist, no private/loopback/link-local IP blocking, no DNS pinning, and no authentication or session check. require_admin() is defined but only used in the set_webhook branch. There is no upstream middleware, since this is a standalone script.

verdict.reason: import.php:11-13 passes unauthenticated $_POST['feed'] straight to file_get_contents and echoes strlen; require_admin() (import.php:4) is only called at line 18 in the set_webhook branch, with no validation of scheme or host.
